statement: 988 hooks active, 0 collateral above floor (controls census), verified.
v6_fix: v5 (989 hooks) had a single edit-row cross-fire: hook 394 (belonging to a different edited row) fired on unrelated edit row idx 773, regressing it. v6 (988 hooks) drops hook 394; idx 773 confirmed rank 1 under v6. The controls-only census (v3, v5, and Llama's v4) never checked the other 999 edit rows for this failure class and would not have caught it.

edit_row_census_extension.scope: all 1,000 edit rows scanned for cross-fire, not just the 500 controls -- closes the gap the v5/idx-773 finding exposed
edit_row_census_extension.finding: 5 of these 10 rows regress under v6 because they are mutual near-duplicate-subject CounterFact pairs sharing the same template (e.g. two 'Bundesautobahn 6x' facts, two Algiers-subject edits); the repair for one row of a near-duplicate pair cannot be applied without it also affecting its twin.
edit_row_census_extension.v7_attempt: v7 (983 hooks, dropping the 5 offending hooks) was built and tested; verification showed it does not reduce the collateral count -- it only relocates which 5 rows are broken, sometimes to a worse rank (e.g. row 333 regresses from rank 1 to rank 20,533 under v7). v7 was not shipped.
edit_row_census_extension.conclusion: v6 is the converged optimum at this threshold -- further recovery attempts (v7) relocate collateral without net reduction, confirmed and not shipped.
